name: Grace Rinaldi
role: Keeps the caff, her Italian father's before her
temper_why: warm, bossy, fierce; forgets nobody (CAST, wave 2 review)

card.who: She keeps Rinaldi's, the caff on the corner of Chapel Lane. Half the street has breakfast there and she hears all of it.
card.speak: Motherly, bossy, quick. Feeds first and asks after.
card.life: Her father came from Italy and opened the caff in 1936. She lives over it. Opens at six for the dock.
card.fire: She fed the firemen till four. One of them said it burned too clean.
card.rivals: The Widow's foreman breakfasts at the window table. Agar's clerk has never set foot in the place.
